g.text: Lagged power absorbs none of the anomaly; cloud proxies some

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Slope of the out-of-fold residual of the median forecast (actual minus forecast) on the shift that CAMS sunshine would cause, median over five series and two seasons, on the training window. A slope of -1 is what a forecast holding none of the anomaly would show if CAMS were exact; a slope nearer 0 means the forecast already holds part of the anomaly, or CAMS is noisy. Each line is d1l with the named columns removed. Exploratory. Training months: April to September 2024 and 2025 (July to September rests on 2024).'
text.tspan: Slope of the out-of-fold residual of the median forecast (actual minus forecast)
on the shift that CAMS sunshine would cause, median over five series and two
seasons, on the training window. A slope of -1 is what a forecast holding none
of the anomaly would show if CAMS were exact; a slope nearer 0 means the
forecast already holds part of the anomaly, or CAMS is noisy. Each line is d1l
with the named columns removed. Exploratory. Training months: April to September
